tooltip.skyblocks.ocean_aquarium: For big tanks: sea animals. Sneak + right-click: choose which ones

tooltip.skyblocks.rain_glass: Right-click with a block or a sky block to see it behind the wet glass

tooltip.skyblocks.fire_tornado: 2 tall. Right-click: on / off. Dye: fire colour. Sneak + right-click: RGB. Whirls to music

tooltip.skyblocks.jellyfish_tank: 2 tall. Right-click: light on / off. Dye: jellyfish colour. Sneak + right-click: RGB
tooltip.skyblocks.koi_pond: Koi and lily pads. Ponds side by side join into one
tooltip.skyblocks.bamboo_spout: A shishi-odoshi for beside a pond: it fills with water, tips and pours into the pond, then knocks back on its stone with a clack
tooltip.skyblocks.music_box: Click to play a tune (sneak-click for the next one). Fish in aquariums and fireflies over ponds nearby move in time with it
tooltip.skyblocks.vanilla_koi_pond: A koi pond in plain Minecraft style: tropical fish, frogs on lily pads, the odd duck and turtle. Ponds side by side join into one. Right-click it to choose what its rim and floor are made of
tooltip.skyblocks.vanilla_aquarium: An aquarium in plain Minecraft style: tropical fish, cod, salmon, pufferfish, axolotls, tadpoles, seagrass and kelp. Touching blocks make one tank
tooltip.skyblocks.vanilla_ocean_aquarium: For big tanks, in plain Minecraft style: dolphins, sea turtles, squid, glow squid, fish and coral. Touching blocks make one tank
tooltip.skyblocks.plasma_ball: Reaches for you when you come close. Right-click: on / off. With a dye: colour. Sneak + right-click: RGB
tooltip.skyblocks.magma_basin: Churning lava. Basins side by side make one pool. Hot to stand in. With a dye: colour
tooltip.skyblocks.singularity: A black hole that keeps what's put in. Right-click: what it holds, and its destroy filter (items, or item tags, crushed to nothing). message.skyblocks.singularity.vacuum_on: Vacuum on: pulling in items from 8 blocks round
gui.skyblocks.singularity.destroyed: Crushed to nothing when it falls in
tooltip.skyblocks.black_hole: Bends the world behind it. With a dye: the dust's colour
tooltip.skyblocks.big_black_hole: Three blocks across, with a glowing accretion disk. With a dye: the disk's colour
tooltip.skyblocks.reef_aquarium: White sand, coral and anemones, reef fish. Touching blocks make one tank. Sneak + right-click: choose which fish
tooltip.skyblocks.jungle_aquarium: Tea-coloured water, driftwood and plants, piranhas and tetras. Touching blocks make one tank. Sneak + right-click: choose which fish
tooltip.skyblocks.small_tank.0: A round glass bowl with a goldfish or two. Right-click: other fish
tooltip.skyblocks.small_tank.1: Stack them for a taller tank, place them in a square (up to 4 x 4) for a wider one - bigger fish the wider it is. Right-click: other fish
tooltip.skyblocks.small_tank.2: Hangs on a wall; side by side and stacked they make one bigger tank. Right-click: other fish
message.skyblocks.tall_tank.2.0: Community tank: angelfish, discus, tetras, guppies
message.skyblocks.tall_tank.3.0: A sea turtle, a grouper and sardines
message.skyblocks.tall_tank.4.0: A little shark and a school of sardines
message.skyblocks.tall_tank.4.2: A manta ray, a sea turtle and sardines
tooltip.skyblocks.tesla_coil: Lightning that reaches for you, arcs to metal blocks near it (any mod's) and to other coils, and goes wild with music. Powered: zaps hostile mobs nearby. Right-click: on / off. With a dye: colour. Sneak + right-click: RGB
tooltip.skyblocks.galaxy_projector: Throws a slowly turning sky on the room round it - best in the dark. Right-click: another sky. Sneak + right-click: on / off
tooltip.skyblocks.orrery: A working clockwork solar system. Right-click: speed (paused, slow, fast, real time). Sneak + right-click: real sizes. Redstone stops it; a comparator reads the Earth's year
tooltip.skyblocks.planetarium: The solar system floating in a dome of stars, 3 blocks across. Right-click: speed (paused, slow, fast, real time). Sneak + right-click: real sizes. Right-click with glass: take the dome off (or put it back). Right-click with an amethyst shard: bigger (3, 6 or 12 blocks across). Redstone stops it; a comparator reads the Earth's year
message.skyblocks.solar.speed.3: Real time: a year in a Minecraft day
tooltip.skyblocks.kaleidoscope: Coloured glass turning in a window on every side. Right-click: its symmetry. Sneak + right-click: its colours. A redstone signal stops it; it pulses with music
tooltip.skyblocks.portal_mirror: Its front is a portal to the nearest other portal mirror of its colour, however far: look in to see what's in front of the other, walk in to come out there. Set it into a wall for a doorway; side by side they make one bigger portal. A dye: its colour
gui.skyblocks.singularity.filter_remove: Click: out of the filter. Right-click: its tags into the box
tooltip.skyblocks.containment_frame: Build along the edges of a 5x5x5, 7x7x7 or 9x9x9 cube round a singularity (nothing solid inside): a containment chamber - the black hole grows to fill it, and the frames work as its sides (right-click, hoppers, pipes)
tooltip.skyblocks.special_frame: Counts as a containment frame: use it in place of any frame of a chamber.
tooltip.skyblocks.port_frame: Moves items between the singularity and containers next to it. Sneak-click: in or out. Right-click with an item: only that item (again: any).
tooltip.skyblocks.display_frame: Shows how many items the singularity holds, how many kinds of how many it can, and how full it is.
tooltip.skyblocks.redstone_frame: Gives off a redstone signal by how full the singularity is, like a comparator.
tooltip.skyblocks.monitor_frame: Right-click with an item: shows that item and how many of it the singularity holds. Sneak-click: clear.
tooltip.skyblocks.whirlpool: Stores fluids: each kind swirls down the vortex as its own band. Buckets and pipes fill and empty it. Right-click: what it holds; sneak-click: drain mode (drains fluid source blocks around it).
tooltip.skyblocks.tank_frame: Build along the edges of a 5x5x5, 7x7x7 or 9x9x9 cube round a whirlpool, with glass on the sides (Tank Glass: no lines between the blocks, one clear pane) and nothing inside: a containment tank - it holds far more.
screen.skyblocks.whirlpool.empty: Empty: use a bucket or a pipe
screen.skyblocks.whirlpool.hint: Click a fluid to void it; click a chip to un-void.
tooltip.skyblocks.effect_block: An animated shader effect of your choosing. Right-click: the effect, its colours (up to 8), speed, size, brightness
tooltip.skyblocks.effect_block.join: Place one against an Effect Block and it joins that effect: it runs across all of them as one
screen.skyblocks.effect_block.preset_emp: Empty: click Save, then here, to keep this look
tooltip.skyblocks.weather_globe: Shows the weather and the time of day outside. Right-click: shake it. With a Sky Island: that island inside. Sneak + right-click: the island back. Sneak + right-click with any wood: the base made of it
tooltip.skyblocks.lava_pillar: Stack them for one tall lamp. Right-click: on / off. With a dye: wax colour. Sneak + right-click: RGB. Sneak + a dye: the liquid's colour. Sneak + right-click with a block: its foot and cap made of it
tooltip.skyblocks.light_bridge_emitter: Two facing each other (up to 32 blocks apart, nothing between) make a walkable bridge of light. Redstone turns it off. A dye: its colour; glowstone dust: rainbow
tooltip.skyblocks.laser_projector: Party lasers in moving patterns - brightest in a fog machine's fog, moving with music. Right-click: on / off. Sneak + right-click: pattern. A dye: colour; glowstone dust: rainbow
tooltip.skyblocks.arcade: Two blocks tall. Right-click to play Snake or Breakout - the cabinet keeps the best scores, shown on its screen
guide.skyblocks.intro:
Shadered+ fills your world with things that move and glow: shader effects, lava lamps, aquariums full of fish, koi ponds, black holes, working solar systems, mirrors that really reflect, portals and whole skies.

Many of them react to music - play a jukebox nearby and watch the dance floors, lasers, visualizers and even the fish move to it.
guide.skyblocks.howto.title: Using this book
guide.skyblocks.howto:
The tabs along the top are the chapters, the same groups as the creative tab.

Pick a block on the left page to read about it on the right: what it does, how to use it and how to craft it.

Click an item in a recipe to go to its page. Scroll a page with the mouse wheel; the arrow keys turn pages too.

The last tab shows the structures: things you build out of several blocks.
guide.skyblocks.structure.containment_ch: Put containment frames along all twelve edges of a cube round a singularity, with nothing solid inside. The black hole grows to fill the chamber and it holds far more. The frames then work as the singularity's sides: right-click them, hoppers and pipes on them. Port, display, monitor and redstone frames can take the place of any frame. Shown here at 5x5x5; 7x7x7 and 9x9x9 work too.
guide.skyblocks.structure.containment_ta: Tank frames along the edges of a cube round a whirlpool, glass on all its sides (Tank Glass makes one clear pane, any glass works) and nothing else inside. The whirlpool holds far more and the whole tank fills with its fluids; buckets and pipes work on the frames. Shown here at 5x5x5; 7x7x7 and 9x9x9 work too.
guide.skyblocks.structure.big_oiia_cat: Place 27 OIIA Cats as a 3x3x3 cube: when the last one goes in, they become one big cat. Give it a redstone signal and it spins.
guide.skyblocks.sky_block: A block that shows a whole sky through it - like a window into another world. Build walls, floors or ceilings of it.
guide.skyblocks.sky_liquid: A liquid that shows its sky as it flows. Pour it anywhere for rivers and waterfalls of sky.
guide.skyblocks.effect_block: A glowing block that plays a shader animation: swirls, plasma, aurora, fire, rain, lava, a Balatro-style vortex, a music spectrum and more - 18 in all. Choose the effect, up to eight colours, a background colour, speed, size, brightness and blur, and save your favourite looks as presets. Blocks placed against each other join into one big picture.
guide.skyblocks.effect_glass: The Effect Block, see-through: its dark parts are clear, so the effect glows like stained glass over whatever is behind it. Joins with Effect Blocks.
guide.skyblocks.neon_sign: A glowing neon sign with your own text. Choose the colour, glow, size and background; signs side by side or stacked join into one bigger sign.
guide.skyblocks.lava_lamp: A classic lava lamp: blobs of warm wax rise, melt together and sink again.
guide.skyblocks.big_lava_lamp: A lava lamp two blocks tall, with bigger blobs.
guide.skyblocks.lava_pillar: A glass column of lava lamp. Stack as many as you like: the wax rises and sinks through the whole height as one tall lamp, merging and parting on the way. It takes the same colours as a lava lamp - any dye or RGB - and its liquid can be dyed too.
guide.skyblocks.plasma_ball: A glass ball of electric tendrils that reach for you when you come close.
guide.skyblocks.tesla_coil: Crackling lightning arcs that jump to you, to metal blocks nearby and between coils.
guide.skyblocks.kaleidoscope: Coloured glass turning in a brass frame, a kaleidoscope picture on every side.
guide.skyblocks.hologram_projector: Projects a turning hologram of any item, of a mob from its spawn egg, or of you.
guide.skyblocks.galaxy_projector: Throws a slowly turning sky of stars and nebulae across the walls and ceiling. Best in a dark room.
guide.skyblocks.weather_globe: A snow globe with a tiny world inside that shows the weather outside - rain, snow, thunder - and the time of day. Shake it for a flurry, or put a Sky Island inside to see your own island in miniature.
guide.skyblocks.disco_ball: A mirror ball throwing spots of light across the room, turning with the music.
guide.skyblocks.dance_floor: Light-up floor tiles. Touching tiles make one floor playing one animation across all of it, moving with the music.
guide.skyblocks.laser_projector: Party lasers: fans, cones, tunnels and scanners sweeping the room, landing as spots on the walls. They react to music and look best in a fog machine's fog.
guide.skyblocks.fog_machine: Fills an area with low, rolling fog. Disco ball beams and lasers shine through it.
guide.skyblocks.speaker: A speaker that thumps with the bass and carries a jukebox's music reaction further.
guide.skyblocks.music_visualizer: A screen of bars and waves dancing to the music nearby. Join several into one big screen.
guide.skyblocks.music_box: Click it and the lid opens, a little dancer turns and it plays a tune on bells. Fish and fireflies nearby move in time with the notes.
guide.skyblocks.arcade: An arcade cabinet, two blocks tall. Its screen plays a demo on an old curved tube; right-click to play Snake or Breakout. The cabinet remembers each game's high score and who got it.
guide.skyblocks.brick_hearth: A big brick fireplace, 2 by 2, with a real-looking fire in any colour.
guide.skyblocks.fire_tornado: A whirling column of fire, two blocks tall, that swirls faster to music.
guide.skyblocks.magma_basin: A pool of churning lava. Basins side by side make one big pool.
guide.skyblocks.water_caustics: Clear water with dancing light on whatever block you put under it.
guide.skyblocks.rain_glass: A rainy window: drops run down the glass in front of the block or sky you put behind it.
guide.skyblocks.aquarium: A fish tank with live fish, plants and bubbles. Touching blocks join into one bigger tank.
guide.skyblocks.ocean_aquarium: An aquarium for big tanks, full of sea animals.
guide.skyblocks.deep_sea_aquarium: Always dark: anglerfish, lanternfish and creatures glowing in the deep.
guide.skyblocks.reef_aquarium: White sand, coral, anemones and bright reef fish.
guide.skyblocks.jungle_aquarium: Tea-coloured water, driftwood and plants, piranhas and tetras.
guide.skyblocks.vanilla_aquarium: An aquarium in plain Minecraft style: tropical fish, cod, salmon, pufferfish and axolotls.
guide.skyblocks.vanilla_ocean_aquarium: A big Minecraft-style tank: dolphins, turtles, squid and glow squid.
guide.skyblocks.aquarium_stand: A cabinet for a tank to sit on.
guide.skyblocks.aquarium_lid: A hood with a lamp for the top of a tank. Click it to change the tank's light.
guide.skyblocks.fishbowl: A round glass bowl with a goldfish or two.
guide.skyblocks.tall_tank: A small tank you can stack taller or set out wider, up to 4 by 4.
guide.skyblocks.slim_tank: A slim tank for walls; side by side and stacked they make one bigger tank.
guide.skyblocks.jellyfish_tank: A tall tank of softly glowing jellyfish drifting up and down.
guide.skyblocks.koi_pond: A pond of koi gliding under lily pads. Ponds side by side join into one.
guide.skyblocks.vanilla_koi_pond: A Minecraft-style pond: tropical fish, frogs on lily pads and the odd duck.
guide.skyblocks.pond_stepping_stone: A stone to walk across a koi pond on. Frogs like to sit on it.
guide.skyblocks.pond_bridge: A row of these on a koi pond makes a little arched bridge, the koi swimming under it.
guide.skyblocks.bamboo_spout: A shishi-odoshi: bamboo that fills with water, tips, pours into the pond and knocks back.
guide.skyblocks.orrery: A working clockwork solar system - the planets really go round the sun.
guide.skyblocks.planetarium: The solar system floating inside a dome of stars, 3 blocks across.
guide.skyblocks.black_hole: A small black hole that bends the world behind it.
guide.skyblocks.big_black_hole: A black hole three blocks across with a glowing accretion disk.
guide.skyblocks.singularity: A black hole that stores items - lots of them. Build a containment chamber round it to hold far more (see Structures).
guide.skyblocks.containment_frame: The frame of a containment chamber round a singularity (see Structures).
guide.skyblocks.port_frame: A chamber frame that moves items between the singularity and containers beside it.
guide.skyblocks.display_frame: A chamber frame that shows how much the singularity holds.
guide.skyblocks.monitor_frame: A chamber frame that shows one item and how many of it the singularity holds.
guide.skyblocks.redstone_frame: A chamber frame that gives a redstone signal by how full the singularity is.
guide.skyblocks.whirlpool: A vortex that stores fluids, each kind swirling down as its own band. Build a containment tank round it to hold far more (see Structures).
guide.skyblocks.tank_frame: The frame of a containment tank round a whirlpool (see Structures).
guide.skyblocks.tank_glass: Glass for containment tanks: no lines between blocks, one clear pane.
guide.skyblocks.mirror: A real mirror: every face shows a live reflection of the world, you included.
guide.skyblocks.round_mirror: A round mirror in a gold ring, hung on a wall.
guide.skyblocks.cracked_mirror: A cracked mirror, its reflection broken up by the cracks.
guide.skyblocks.vanity_mirror: A mirror framed with bulbs, like a dressing room's.
guide.skyblocks.infinity_mirror: A tunnel of LED rings going on forever. Side by side on a wall they make one big frame.
guide.skyblocks.infinity_cube: Six half mirrors with LED strips inside: a glowing grid going on forever in every direction. Fill a box with them for one big cube.
guide.skyblocks.portal_mirror: Look through it to see the nearest other portal mirror of the same colour - and walk through to go there.
guide.skyblocks.light_bridge_emitter: Two of these facing each other, up to 32 blocks apart, make a bridge of solid light you can walk on. Dye it any colour, or rainbow.
guide.skyblocks.island_scanner: Scans the area around it into a Sky Island item: a little copy of it, mobs included, to keep and show in paintings, on pedestals or in a weather globe.
guide.skyblocks.island_painting: A framed shadow box for the wall with a Sky Island inside. Right-click it with an ender pearl to go to where the island was scanned.
guide.skyblocks.oiia_cat: The spinning cat. Give it redstone to make it spin; 27 of them in a cube make a big one (see Structures).
